chunks: I call to witness those who scatter (dust) by dispersing,
ai.seo_question: What does the oath of the scattering winds in Surah Adh-Dhariyat signify?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath by the 'scattering winds' highlights the precision of divine governance, where natural phenomena serve as signs of the inevitable Day of Judgment. The verse underscores the certainty of the Hereafter, reinforcing the concept that just as winds disperse dust with exactitude, so too will God resurrect and judge humanity with absolute justice.
